For those with discerning palates, Chin Chin on Flinders Lane offers a wide range of Asian fusion dishes in a lively and bustling atmosphere, perfectly reflecting the diversity of Melbourne's cuisine. Meanwhile, Hardware Societe, a cosy café on Hardware Lane, serves some of Melbourne's best brunch, including signature French toast and expertly crafted coffee. It's a little haven away from the hustle and bustle and the perfect place to go in the morning after a busy week of studying. When it comes to groceries, the Queen Victoria Market offers not only fresh produce but also an authentic Melbourne experience. Here, students can savour local delicacies, source ingredients from all over the world, and soak up the rich atmosphere of this historic market. For shopping enthusiasts, Emporium Melbourne is a must. This sleek and modern shopping centre has a wide range of high-end brands and designer shops to suit all tastes and budgets. Located in the city's heart, this shopping centre is an excellent place for students to update their wardrobes, shop for essentials or enjoy window shopping. Movie lovers can find solace at The Kino Cinema on Collins Street, a charming art house cinema showing mainstream, independent and foreign films. The cinema is an intimate setting, away from the hustle and bustle of the larger theatres, offering a unique viewing experience. 
 
Transport:
Scape Lincoln College is minutes from a tram stop, Melbourne Central Station is within easy reach, and the CBD is a 13-minute walk away.
RMIT City Campus: 6 minutes walk, 3 minutes by bike, 2 minutes by car
University of Melbourne: 5 minutes walk, 3 minutes by bike, 2 minutes by car
RMIT University of Technology (RMIT): 5 minutes walk
Australian Catholic University Melbourne Campus: 5 minutes by car
Victoria University City Queen Campus: 8 minutes by car
 
Security and Services:
Scape Lincoln College offers 24-hour security, including surveillance equipment and an access control system to ensure security and privacy. A professional property management team is available within the building to assist and support residents at all times. The cleanliness and maintenance of public areas have also been ensured, creating a clean, tidy, and safe living environment for students.
